legend: You are given a matrix consisting of digits zero and one, its size is n × m. You are allowed to rearrange its rows. What is the maximum area of the submatrix that only consists of ones and can be obtained in the given problem by the described operations?

Let's assume that the rows of matrix a are numbered from 1 to n from top to bottom and the columns are numbered from 1 to m from left to right. A matrix cell on the intersection of the i-th row and the j-th column can be represented as (i, j). Formally, a submatrix of matrix a is a group of four integers d, u, l, r (1 ≤ d ≤ u ≤ n; 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ m). We will assume that the submatrix contains cells (i, j) (d ≤ i ≤ u; l ≤ j ≤ r). The area of the submatrix is the number of cells it contains.
input: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 5000). Next n lines contain m characters each — matrix a. Matrix a only contains characters: "0" and "1". Note that the elements of the matrix follow without any spaces in the lines.
output: Print a single integer — the area of the maximum obtained submatrix. If we cannot obtain a matrix of numbers one, print 0.

legend.ai: 给定一个由数字 0 和 1 组成的 n × m 矩阵。你可以重新排列矩阵的行。通过题目所述的操作，能够得到的仅由 1 组成的子矩阵的最大面积是多少？

假设矩阵 a 的行从上到下编号为 1 到 n，列从左到右编号为 1 到 m。第 i 行与第 j 列交叉处的矩阵单元格可以表示为 (i, j)。形式化地说，矩阵 a 的一个子矩阵由四个整数 d、u、l、r 组成（1 ≤ d ≤ u ≤ n；1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ m）。我们规定该子矩阵包含所有满足 (d ≤ i ≤ u；l ≤ j ≤ r) 的单元格 (i, j)。子矩阵的面积就是它所包含的单元格数量。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n，m ≤ 5000）。接下来的 n 行每行包含 m 个字符，即矩阵 a。矩阵 a 只包含字符“0”和“1”。注意，矩阵的元素在每行中连续给出，字符之间没有空格。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即所能得到的最大子矩阵的面积。如果无法得到一个全部由 1 组成的矩阵，则输出 0。
